Title: Azure Red Hat OpenShift private endpoints now in preview

Body.Content:
Support for private endpoints in Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now available in preview. This enables private endpoints for the API server in clusters deployed in East US 2. Support for additional regions will be added soon.

Learn more
